gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all issue type schemes available in the Jira Cloud platform so that I can understand the different configurations that can be applied to my projects.
gold.ideal: The response should include a list of all issue type schemes with their IDs, names, and descriptions.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to create a new issue type scheme that includes specific issue types for my team's workflow, ensuring that we have the right structure for our projects.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the creation of the issue type scheme and return the new scheme's ID and details.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to get the mapping of issue type schemes to projects to understand which schemes are applied to which projects.
gold.ideal: The response should provide a mapping of project IDs to their corresponding issue type scheme IDs.

gold.user: As a product owner, I want to find out which issue type scheme is assigned to a specific project so that I can review its configuration.
gold.ideal: The response should return the issue type scheme ID and name associated with the specified project.

gold.user: As a project administrator, I want to assign an existing issue type scheme to a project to ensure that the project uses the correct issue types.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the assignment of the issue type scheme to the project and return the updated project details.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I need to delete an obsolete issue type scheme that is no longer in use to keep our configurations clean and manageable.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the deletion of the issue type scheme and indicate that it can no longer be used.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to update an existing issue type scheme to include new issue types that reflect our evolving project needs.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the update and return the modified issue type scheme details.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to add new issue types to an existing issue type scheme to accommodate additional workflows in our projects.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the addition of the issue types and return the updated list of issue types in the scheme.

gold.user: As a project lead, I want to reorder the issue types in an issue type scheme to reflect the priority of tasks in our workflow.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the new order of issue types and return the updated scheme details.

gold.user: As a project administrator, I need to remove an issue type from an issue type scheme that is no longer relevant to our projects.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the removal of the issue type and return the updated list of issue types in the scheme.
